formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P16 — Cross-Reservoir Behavioral-Evidence Linkability, Naturalistic Exact-State Replay Readiness, Transition-Timing Byte-Custody Recovery, Handcrafted↔Learned Representation Development Authority, Observation-Fiber Re-entry Support & Multi-Observable Successor Readiness Census
core_question: Which existing CUBE-REV evidence reservoirs are actually executable, linkable, and authority-compatible enough to support the next highest-information discriminator without unnecessary fresh acquisition?

G7_NATURALISTIC_EXACT_STATE.authority: current exact replay + search geometry + fresh naturalistic cohorts
G7_NATURALISTIC_EXACT_STATE.current_limit: P13/P14/P15 contacted cohorts are development/negative-legacy, not fresh confirmation

LEARNED_LATENT_POLICY.authority: can train/freeze on prior contacted naturalistic corpora
LEARNED_LATENT_POLICY.current_limit: no canonical representation compiler/model yet; fresh confirmation remains required

R1_SENSOR_TIMING.authority: R1.42/R1.53 sealed timing microstructure and transition-excess semantic receipts
R1_SENSOR_TIMING.current_limit: historical artifacts point to local /mnt/data; current Drive/active repo search has not recovered replay bytes

R1_PUBLIC_TIMING.authority: R1.47/R1.48 corrected public timing semantic surface
R1_PUBLIC_TIMING.current_limit: mixed annotation semantics; corrected raw/derived artifacts not currently recovered in canonical byte custody

OBSERVATION_FIBER_EXACT.authority: 2x2 exact-state/ideal-observer/aliasing lineage retained by doctrine and Notion
OBSERVATION_FIBER_EXACT.current_limit: NET-24/observation-fiber implementation is absent from active research/current code search after repository pruning

successor_forks.P17_A: Handcrafted exact geometry ↔ learned latent representation tournament
successor_forks.P17_B: Choice × timing multi-observable bridge, only after timing byte custody/link keys are recovered
successor_forks.P17_C: Observation-fiber × naturalistic behavior bridge, only after exact observation compiler recovery
successor_forks.P17_D: Recovery-target reconstitution if next-action prediction is judged the wrong target

decision_rule: Prefer the successor with the strongest discriminator and smallest fresh-contact cost.
Do not let historical sample size substitute for confirmation authority.
Do not launch timing bridge from semantic summaries alone; byte-level replayability is required.
Do not train learned latent representation on any sample later claimed as fresh confirmation.
Do not revive metadata owner hypotheses defeated by P15 without a genuinely new representation-level discriminator.
